6.211 rsCantMakeTableGroupHeadersFixed
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
rsCantMakeTableGroupHeadersFixed is a critical error that will occur if a TableGroup.Header has
Header.FixedHeader set to true.
